name: Mob Psycho 100
tagline: An overpowered psychic just wants to be normal
description: Shigeo Kageyama (Mob) is an eighth-grader with immense psychic powers who just wants to live a normal life and improve himself. From the creator of One Punch Man, this series features incredible animation, emotional depth, and themes about self-improvement.
pros: Some of the best animation ever
cons: Slower start than One Punch Man
